name: Bag of Beans

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Plant a bean
powers.text: Plant a bean in soil and water it: something happens a minute later (roll on the Bag of Beans table).

summary: 3d4 magic beans; plant one and see what grows (anything from a fountain of berries to a hostile monster).
text: The heavy cloth sack holds 3d4 dry beans. The bag's weight is 1/2 pound, with another 1/4 pound added per bean. Empty the whole bag onto the ground and the beans explode, filling a 10-foot radius around them with fire: every creature there, you included, attempts a Dexterity saving throw against DC 15; a failed save means 5d4 Fire damage, and a success halves it. Flammable objects in the blast that nobody is wearing or carrying catch fire. Alternatively, take one bean out, bury it in sand or dirt and water it; 1 minute later something happens at that spot, determined by the Bag of Beans table (roll for it).
